verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents a public API covering its core billing functions: the Subscriptions API, the Trial Offer API, the Billing Meters API with a meter-event API reference page, and webhooks. Its MCP server is also documented as letting AI agents interact with the Stripe API, and the docs are served in agent-friendly llms.txt and .md form. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving Billing through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
Use the Trial Offer API to manage both free and paid introductory periods for your subscriptions with a single API integration.
Meter events represent actions that customers take in your system. You can use meter events to bill a customer based on their usage.
Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
